findings.why: BR-220 belongs to PRG-X, which is an Aurelia program. Changing the CNC program and fixture for BR-220 machining is a change of manufacturing process. Aurelia revision 4 (replaces rev 3) requires written approval (PPAP resubmission) before shipping and notification at least 90 days before implementation. No approval or notification in the documents covers this change, and implementation is planned for next week. Nothing in force covers it.
